messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Is the periodic verification of the DEMAG overhead crane at position 8 of the IGEA list overdue today?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Allegato VII D.Lgs. 81/2008 verifiche periodiche attrezzature di lavoro apparecchi di sollevamento periodicità biennale annuale; Annex VII Legislative Decree 81/2008 periodic inspection of lifting equipment interval", "IGEA elenco apparecchi di sollevamento posizione 8 gru a portale DEMAG data ultima verifica periodica; IGEA list lifting devices position 8 DEMAG overhead crane last periodic inspection date", "DEMAG overhead crane operating manual periodic inspection interval months maintenance schedule; manuale d'uso gru DEMAG intervallo verifica periodica mesi", "DPR 462/2001 art. 6 verifica periodica impianti di messa a terra e apparecchi di sollevamento; verifiche periodiche ogni due anni ASL ARPA organismo abilitato, periodic verification lifting devices every two years"]}
